description:
Most people send their paycheck to a checking account, spend it, and invest whatever is left over.

I do the opposite.

Every dollar I earn goes into my brokerage account first. I fully invest that capital into productive assets that generate income, grow equity, and keep compounding over time. Then what dividends don’t cover, I responsibly borrow against my equity to fund life while keeping my capital working.

That’s the Paycheck to Portfolio system.

In this video, I walk you step by step through how I actually live out of my brokerage account, how margin and equity really work, how money flows through the system, and why I view my portfolio like a business instead of a bank account.

Money comes in.
Margin goes down.
Equity goes up.
Equity gets redeployed into productive assets.
Income keeps flowing.
Ownership keeps growing.

That’s the cycle.

I also break down:
✔ My current portfolio update
✔ Dividend cash flow projections
✔ Time-weighted returns vs the S&P 500 / Nasdaq
✔ How brokerage debit cards and bill pay work
✔ Margin maintenance explained simply
✔ Why fully deployed capital can be more efficient than idle cash

This is how I’m building wealth in real time.

Appreciate each and every one of you being part of this journey.
